$comment: Single source of truth for which hooks The Agency wires into settings.json. Read by cli/lib/hooks-merge.js (install.sh, install.ps1, agency init, agency upgrade, agency hooks sync|remove). {root} is replaced by the resolved agency root. The table in docs/HOOKS.md is generated from this file: node .github/scripts/check-hooks-manifest.js --write. To stop shipping a hook, move its entry to "retired" (id, event, command) so existing installs get it pruned.

hooks.purpose: Gate writes to sensitive files (settings, agents, hooks, SKILL.md)
Block modification of existing linter/formatter configs
Scan shell commands for credential-looking patterns
Generalist-switch gate: unknown or archived agent types get an ask pointing to agents-archive/ROLE-MAP.md
Buffer edited file paths for batch checking at session end
Log path + byte count of deliverable-shaped writes (paper trail against fabricated completions)
Detect stall loops: 5 identical tool calls in a row triggers a warning
Check that files an agent claims to have delivered exist on disk
Fast-forward the agency root's config from GitHub on session open
Warn if settings.json has plaintext tokens in MCP env blocks
Detect an unclean prior exit (crash / Ctrl+C)
Mark the session cleanly ended, typecheck/shellcheck edited files, record session cost
